problems_and_friction: No command failures. Two friction points: (1) after patch-data the CLI hinted 'human view is stale - clan render to refresh', but running render would have regenerated the view and risked clobbering the hand-built HTML from stages 1-2, so I deliberately skipped it and used patch-html instead (the hint is misleading for full-html documents); (2) dumping the human view via PowerShell redirection produced a UTF-16 file with mangled euro signs in my read-back, which was cosmetic but made inspection noisier. The agent-help quick reference made tool discovery otherwise painless.
context_understood: I was hop 3 of 3 (lead partner) receiving a .clan document carrying stage-1 CRM market research and stage-2 risk analysis for Brightline (40-person Dublin ad agency), and had to synthesize a single costed recommendation (HubSpot, ~EUR 70k year-1), a 3-phase rollout plan, an executive summary, and explicit specialist-weighing rationale into final.clan with both structured data and a polished HTML view.
